dataset_provenance: User-supplied food wastage dataset (1,782 raw records, unverified external source)
target_interpretation: Food Surplus Amount (units as recorded in dataset)

metric_definitions.mae: Mean Absolute Error: Average absolute difference between predicted and actual surplus units.
metric_definitions.rmse: Root Mean Squared Error: Square root of mean squared error, penalizing larger deviations.
metric_definitions.r2: R-squared: Proportion of surplus variance explained by the features.
